output.summary: A rhizomatous flowering plant native to temperate eastern Asia, it has grey-green leaves, unbranched stems and early-summer flowers ranging from blue to red-violet, with rare white forms. Most parts, including the rhizome and leaves, are poisonous if eaten and may cause stomach pain and vomiting.
